thread:
sam: quick question — who turned my helm values into modern art last night? :laughing:
yana: guilty. i was trying to be "minimalist" with indentation.
tom: minimalism != valid yaml. paste?
sam: here
```yaml
deploy:
  chart: app
    values:
      replicas: 3
```
zoe: oh no. the "values" decided to existentially indent itself.
devops-bot: deployment blocked — template rendering error: service.yaml: line 3: did not find expected key
yana: sorry, my editor auto-indented when i saved. the classic invisible tab strike. :grimacing:
tom: PSA: enable show-whitespace in vim/emacs/ide. it will save friendships.
sam: also had a semver tiny tragedy in staging — marketing pushed 2.5.0 -> 2.5.0 and the release checker yelled about "non-incremental version"
zoe: how do you accidentally keep the same version? generational amnesia? :thinking_face:
yana: they copied the line and forgot to bump. maybe we need a pre-merge hook 
  that enforces increment or accepts date-based suffixes.
devops-bot: suggestion: add a pre-commit hook "check-semver" and a yamllint job to CI. see: https://internal.redwood.tools/devflows#hooks
tom: vote time — which is the bigger mood-killer: YAML whitespace or semver fence fights?
sam: YAML (you stare at spaces for 20 minutes trying to find the gremlin)
yana: semver (standup turns into parliament)
zoe: tie — both require cookies.
devops-bot: log note created in #infra: "add yamllint and semver-check to pre-merge"
tom: ok i'll make the hook and a tiny README: "How to not break CI (or your soul)". stickers optional. :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
